verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              उपोह्यमाने द्यूते तु राजानः सर्व एव ते। धृतराष्ट्रं पुरस्कृत्य विविशुस्तां सभां ततः॥१॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said When the play commenced, all the kings, Dhritarashtra being at their head, took their seats in that Assembly hall.

verses.sanskrit: भीष्मो द्रोणः कृपश्चैव विदुरश्च महामतिः। नातिप्रीतेन मनसा तेऽन्ववर्तन्त भारत॥२॥
verses.english: O descendant of Bharata, Bhishma, Drona, Kripa, the high-souled Vidura followed their example with cheerless heart.

verses.sanskrit: ते द्वन्द्वशः पृथक्चैव सिंहग्रीवा महौजसः। सिंहासनानि भूरिणी विचित्राणि च भेजिरे॥३॥
verses.english: Those lion-necked and greatly effulgeit (kings) took their seats separately and in praise on may high (royal) seats of various make and colour.

verses.sanskrit: शुशुभे सा सभा राजन्राजभिस्तैः समागतैः। देवैरिव महाभागैः समवेतैस्त्रिविष्टपम्॥४॥
verses.english: O king, that Assembly-hall looked beautiful with the assembled monarchs like the heaven with a conclave of greatly fortunate celestials.

verses.sanskrit: सर्वे वेदविदः शूराः सर्वे भास्वरमूर्तयः। प्रावर्तत महाराज सुहृद्द्यूतमनन्तरम्॥५॥
verses.english: O great king, they were all heroes, they were all learned in the Vedas, and they all bore resplendent countenances. The friendly match at dice then commenced (in due form).

verses.sanskrit:
युधिष्ठिर उवाच।
              अयं बुहधनो राजन्सागरावर्तसम्भवः। मणिर्हारोत्तरः श्रीमान्कनकोत्तमभूषणः॥६॥
verses.english: Yudhishthira said O king, this excellent and most valuable chain of pearls, so beautiful and adorned with gold and procured from the ocean by churning it,

verses.sanskrit: एतद्राजन्मम धनं प्रतिपाणोऽस्ति कस्तव। येन मां त्वं महाराज धनेन प्रतिदीव्यसे॥७॥
verses.english: O king, is my stake. O great king, what is your counter stake, the wealth with which you wish to play with me?

verses.sanskrit:
दुर्योधन उवाच।
              सन्ति मे मणयश्चैव धनानि सुबहूनि च। मत्सरश्च न मेऽर्थेषु जयस्वैनं दुरोदरम्॥८॥
verses.english: Duryodhana said I have many jewels and much wealth, but I am not proud of them. However, let yourself win this stake.

verses.sanskrit:
वैशम्पायन उवाच।
              ततो जग्राह शकुनिस्तानक्षानक्षतत्त्ववित्। जितमित्येव शकुनिर्युधिष्ठिरमभाषत॥९॥
verses.english: Vaishampayana said Thereupon Shakuni, well-skilled in dice, took up the dice and said to Yudhishthira, “Lo, I have won it".
verses.bhavadeepa: दुरोदरं पणम् । अर्थेषु त्वया स्थापितेषु मत्सरः हीनमौल्यत्वादिदोषबुद्धिः ॥८॥
